63K likes, 1,121 comments - elleindia on September 4, 2026: "#ELLEDigitalCoverStar: For women who did not see themselves in the delicate, fair-skinned ideal that popular culture had at the time, Bipasha Basu (@bipashabasu) offered another possibility. She was tall, athletic, tanned and visibly strong, and none of those things were presented as something she needed to soften. Her look in ‘Jism’ became as memorable as the film. Bronzed skin, kohl-heavy eyes, textured hair, white against the beach. “Suddenly the waves and the tongs and the big kohl, the bronze skin, everything started trending in a big way. The look completely changed, and people really started accepting the bold. So I do think there are things that I have done which changed the way a woman looked at that point of time in our business for the better.” She adds. 
Read more from our conversation at the 🔗 in bio
________________________________________
On @bipashabasu: Embroidered strap silk column dress by @balmain via @galerieslafayetteindia. Turquoise, Opal and Diamond ring, all by @pctandsons.

32K likes, 335 comments - elleindia on September 4, 2026: "#ELLEDigitalCoverStar: “Ageing is like the biggest sin that you can commit,” Bipasha Basu (@bipashabasu) laughs. “I believe that I like myself more, the person that I am today, much more than what I used to be in my twenties.” She has no interest in chasing a younger version of herself. “What other people are doing, it’s their call. I don’t judge that. But for me, I’m never going to fall into the pressure of wanting to look younger than what I am. I’m very happy with the way I am growing older, and I’m very proud of my age.” Read more from our conversation at the 🔗 in bio.
______________________________________
On @bipashabasu: Antique gold sequin corset gown and cape, both by @rockystarofficial .
